methodologyNotes: Dataset covers thirteen 12-24 V cordless drill/driver and hammer-drill models spanning entry-level brushed tools through professional brushless platforms. Primary sources were manufacturer product pages (DeWalt, Milwaukee, Makita, Bosch, Ryobi, Craftsman, Ridgid, Metabo HPT, Kobalt, Skil) supplemented by reputable tool-review sources (Pro Tool Reviews, ToolGuyd, TechReviewer, ToolBoxBuzz) and authorized-retailer listings (Acme Tools, Toolup, CPO Outlets). Torque values are max torque in inch-pounds as stated by the manufacturer; brushless is a boolean (true = brushless motor, false = brushed); weight_lb is bare-tool or tool-with-battery as noted per product. priceUsd reflects the best-available, live-verified US price for the exact model/config named; null is used where no current published USD price could be confirmed from a live source (a null beats a guess). All values re-verified 2026-06-19. accessedAt 2026-06-19.
